source: The Fantasy Arsenal locked manual stat-trend tuner

dynamic_rest_of_season.purpose: Replace a stale fixed full-season budget with a progressively updated per-game stat expectation while heavily regressing touchdowns.

_instructions: Edit this file, save it, then run: npm run tune
enabled controls whether a position or stat participates.
minimum_games on each stat controls when that component begins adjusting. The position minimum_games is only the fallback when a stat omits it.
up_weight and down_weight control trend strength by direction. Optional max_up_move_pct and max_down_move_pct override the shared component cap.
Role multipliers let the same component react differently for newcomer/established starters and reserves. Keep them at 1 until testing a role hypothesis.
Directional weights control how strongly that stat follows its current-season trend. 0 ignores that direction; 0.5 is cautious; 1 is full; values above 1 are aggressive.
prior_games controls shrinkage. Lower reacts faster; higher trusts the historical baseline longer.
max_stat_move_pct caps that individual volume or efficiency-rate change. Use decimals: 0.25 means 25%.
overall_weight controls how much of the combined stat-line change reaches the fantasy projection.
max_total_move_pct caps the final fantasy projection change in either direction.
Stats not used by a position are ignored. Attempts/targets/carries alter volume; yards, catches, TDs, and interceptions alter the corresponding per-opportunity rate.
A disabled rate remains fixed, but its projected total can still move when an enabled volume changes. Example: pass attempts can move interceptions at an unchanged interception rate.
The tuner adds the bounded fantasy-point change from the adjusted stat line to Arsenal Safe; it does not multiply Safe by a proxy-derived percentage.
Use the FANTASY marginal column to decide whether a component helps the full projection. Component stat MAE improvements are diagnostic and are not automatically additive.
Do not edit evaluation years to chase a better result. Repeated runs make 2024-2025 development data; final verification must use separate evidence.

manual_stat_trend.baseline_source: earliest exact immutable pre-kickoff Safe stat line available for each player
